_about: Facts the dataset cards quote that croissant/*.json does not carry as structured fields. Read by scripts/export_dataset_cards.py (#150). Every entry has a value and the committed source it was read from. in_croissant: true means the value, formatted as the card prints it, must also appear somewhere in that card's Croissant file; the renderer refuses to render if it does not, so the card and the Croissant record cannot disagree on it. Integers are printed with thousands separators; strings are printed verbatim.
